instructions.task: Identify zero or more shared upstream external economic drivers. Different wording may belong to the same causal chain. Do not require lexical similarity.
instructions.no_outside_knowledge: Use only the supplied evidence. Do not infer company identity. Do not recommend securities.
instructions.edge_requirement: Every accepted company-driver edge must cite evidence_id(s).
instructions.driver_requirement: Driver must be external to company bookkeeping/internal administration and must transmit into demand/orders/usage/pricing/revenue/volume/capacity/capex/customer activity.
instructions.minimums: A passed driver needs >=4 companies, >=2 B2 cluster aliases, >=2 companies outside its dominant cluster, and mean edge confidence >=0.70.
instructions.output: Return structured driver objects with driver_name, causal_chain, member_aliases, per_member evidence_ids/edge_confidence/evidence_directness, counterevidence, pass.
